title: fix(ie11): preact-compat algolia fork with #423
body: This is to fix an [issue of preact-compat](https://github.com/developit/preact-compat/pull/423) on IE11. It uses an algolia fork of preact-compat, that we need to replace once the new version is out (3.17.1 or 3.18.0)
